hero.eyebrow: AI Training Plans × Real Workout Partners
hero.headline: AI plans. We train together.
hero.sub: From personalized training plans and partner matching to real workout execution, PacerGo helps every session feel clearer and easier to sustain.
hero.trust: Free to join. Explore first. Upgrade AI when you need it.

steps.intro: PacerGo connects AI planning with optional human support, then keeps the training loop moving in the Web App.

items.title: AI plan
items.body: Set a goal and create a practical training direction in the Web App.

items.title: Human support
items.body: Find a workout partner when accountability or in-person support would help.

items.title: Train
items.body: Use the plan, meet when it helps, and complete the session at your pace.

items.title: Review progress
items.body: Record training activity and review progress so the next session is clearer.

ai_coach.intro: PacerGo helps turn your goal and training conditions into a structured workout menu, so you know what to do next.

items.title: Personalized planning
items.body: Choose your goal, age group, level, frequency, and training place.

items.title: Workout structure
items.body: Build a session format with warm-up, main training, and cool-down.

items.title: Next-step guidance
items.body: Use the plan as a starting point before training alone or with a partner.

ai_coach.visual_note: Approved AI plan screenshots will be placed here when available.

tiers.intro: When you want accountability, find workout support that fits the plan, the activity, and the pace you want.
tiers.rate_note: Each partner sets their own rate

items.name: Top Tier
items.blurb: Partners at this level submit approved proof for the selected activity before listing at this level.

items.name: Senior Pro
items.blurb: Experienced workout partners can support users with practical training experience after the required review.

items.name: Buddy
items.blurb: Workout partners who want to show up and train together, free or at a small fee when they choose.

progress.intro: PacerGo connects planning with execution: view your plan, complete workouts, record activity, and review progress.

items.title: View the plan
items.body: Keep the training direction visible before the session starts.

items.title: Complete workouts
items.body: Train alone or with support, depending on what helps you follow through.

items.title: Record activity
items.body: Use the Web App to keep track of completed training.

items.title: Review progress
items.body: Check weekly progress and use it to shape the next session.

progress.visual_note: Approved training and progress screenshots will be placed here when available.

safety.intro: PacerGo combines profile information, reporting, blocking, and in-person safety guidance. These tools support safer decisions, but they are not a guarantee.

items.title: Tier A verification
items.body: Tier A partners submit credentials for review before verified status appears.

items.title: Report & block
items.body: Report concerns for moderation and block users you do not want to see or contact.

items.title: Share your session
items.body: Share who, where, and when with a trusted contact before heading out.

items.title: Meet in public
items.body: First-meet guidance and public-venue suggestions help early sessions stay lower-risk.

cta.sub: AI helps you plan, and real people help you follow through.
cta.launching: Available in Taiwan · 繁體中文 & English
